title: Eventual coherent adicness of the explicit quotient
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_adic_bound {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H) (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l), Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) = Subobject.mk (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op))) (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅ Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op), e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫ F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m)) : ∃ b : ℕ, ∀ d : ℕ, max c b ≤ d → IsCoherentFormalModule I (formalShiftedQuotient I S d)

proof.text: Coherent kernel/cokernel closure proves that Abelian.image of each kernel-transition map is coherent. Transport quasi-coherence and finite type across hS using isFiniteType_of_epi. The already proved formalCompletionSystem_coherent gives coherence of each quotient. The multiplication-cokernel calculation gives annihilation by its defining ideal power.
Choose the eventual comparison bound and combine those isomorphisms with coherence and annihilation, the three clauses of IsCoherentFormalModule.
